label: Postgres: Query
description: Run SQL against a Postgres database and get the rows back. Use $1-style placeholders with the params list; cast placeholders for non-text types ($1::int).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The database's connection (wire a PostgresAccess node, or a PostgresDatabase's access output).

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Values for $1, $2, ... A string binds as text, a number to whichever numeric column it meets, null to any column, an object as jsonb; cast in the SQL for other types.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: The answered rows keyed by column name.
